lore: Off DiskSaver Island the caches are carved into five reef stones, every row guarded by a parity stone. Storms smash a stone now and then. Rebuild it from the others before the next storm, or the row is gone.

lines.start: Five stones, one parity in every row. Lose one stone and we can still read it back.
lines.storm: Storm took a stone. Rebuild it before the sky recharges.
lines.rebuild: Rows coming back, block by block. Each one checks out.
lines.healthy: Every stone whole again. Let it blow.
lines.win: The season's over and not a byte was lost.
lines.fail: Two blocks gone in one row. That row is lost to the sea.
